[題號] 1
📌 參考答案
B. 草
B. Grass
📌 詳細解釋
表格顯示植物 I 具有花、種子和葉綠素，因此必然是被子植物（開花植物）。
The table shows plant I possesses flowers, seeds, and chlorophyll, indicating it is an angiosperm (flowering plant).
草是被子植物，符合所有特徵。
Grass is an angiosperm and matches all characteristics.
松樹（裸子植物）沒有花，冬菇和麵包黴（真菌）缺乏葉綠素、種子和花，因此選項 A、C 和 D 皆錯誤。
Pine (gymnosperm) lacks flowers, while mushroom and bread mould (fungi) lack chlorophyll, seeds, and flowers; thus options A, C, and D are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
被子植物是唯一具有花的植物分類。
Angiosperms are the only plant group that possess flowers.
常見錯誤：誤以為草沒有花或松樹會開花。
Common trap：Mistakenly thinking grass has no flowers or pine trees produce flowers.

[題號] 2
📌 參考答案
D. IV 裸子植物
D. IV Gymnosperm
📌 詳細解釋
植物 IV 具有種子和葉綠素，但沒有花，這是裸子植物的典型特徵。
Plant IV has seeds and chlorophyll but no flowers, which are the typical characteristics of gymnosperms.
植物 I 有花，應為被子植物；植物 II 沒有葉綠素，應為真菌。
Plant I has flowers and should be an angiosperm; Plant II lacks chlorophyll and should be a fungus.
植物 III 有葉綠素但無種子和花，應為藻類、蘚類或蕨類植物。
Plant III has chlorophyll but no seeds or flowers, representing algae, mosses, or ferns.
📌 考試提醒
裸子植物產生裸露的種子，但不開花。
Gymnosperms produce naked seeds but do not bear flowers.
常見錯誤：將舊稱「菌類」及「羊齒」當作標準答案，DSE 現代標準為「真菌」及「蕨類」。
Common trap：Treating old terms like "菌類" and "羊齒" as standard; modern DSE standards use "fungi" and "ferns".

[題號] 3
📌 參考答案
C. 3→2→4→1
C. 3→2→4→1
📌 詳細解釋
該圖顯示植物根尖細胞有絲分裂的不同階段。
The diagram shows the different stages of mitotic cell division in plant root tip cells.
階段 3 為前期（染色體變短變粗），階段 2 為中期（染色體排列在赤道板）。
Stage 3 is prophase (chromosomes shorten and thicken), and stage 2 is metaphase (chromosomes align at the equator).
階段 4 為後期（姊妹染色單體分離並移向兩極），階段 1 為末期（形成兩個新細胞）。
Stage 4 is anaphase (sister chromatids separate and move to opposite poles), and stage 1 is telophase (formation of two new cells).
因此正確的順序是 3→2→4→1，其他選項的排序皆不符合細胞週期。
Therefore, the correct sequence is 3→2→4→1, and other options do not match the cell cycle.
📌 考試提醒
有絲分裂確保子細胞保留與母細胞完全相同的染色體數目及基因組成。
Mitosis ensures daughter cells retain the exact same chromosome number and genetic makeup as the parent cell.
常見錯誤：混淆中期（排列赤道板）和後期（分離移向兩極）的顯微鏡特徵。
Common trap：Confusing the microscopic features of metaphase (alignment at equator) and anaphase (separation to opposite poles).

[題號] 4
📌 參考答案
C. 只有(1)和(3)
C. (1) and (3) only
📌 詳細解釋
有絲分裂發生於體細胞的形成過程，以增加細胞數目作生長或修補之用。
Mitosis occurs during the formation of somatic cells to increase cell number for growth or repair.
皮膚細胞和紅血球均為體細胞，由幹細胞經有絲分裂產生。
Skin cells and red blood cells are both somatic cells produced from stem cells via mitosis.
精子細胞是配子（單倍體），由生殖器官內的細胞經減數分裂產生，而非有絲分裂。
Sperm cells are gametes (haploid) produced by cells in reproductive organs via meiosis, not mitosis.
📌 考試提醒
體細胞由有絲分裂產生，配子由減數分裂產生。
Somatic cells are produced by mitosis, while gametes are produced by meiosis.
常見錯誤：誤以為成熟紅血球無細胞核，就不是由有絲分裂衍生而來。
Common trap：Mistakenly thinking that since mature red blood cells lack a nucleus, they are not derived from mitosis.

小圓片 I 含有唾液澱粉酶，能將澱粉分解，因此加入碘液後呈現不含澱粉的棕色區。

酶的活性會受極端 pH 值和高溫所破壞（變性）。
Enzyme activity is destroyed (denatured) by extreme pH values and high temperatures.

[題號] 6
📌 參考答案
D. 碘液與棕色區下層的澱粉結合。
D. Iodine solution binds with the starch in the lower layer of the brown region.
📌 詳細解釋
澱粉瓊脂具有一定厚度，唾液澱粉酶在短時間內可能只分解了表層的澱粉。
Starch agar has a certain thickness, and salivary amylase might have only digested the starch on the surface layer within a short time.
經過幾分鐘後，碘液滲透到較底層，與未被分解的澱粉產生反應，呈現藍黑色。
After a few minutes, the iodine solution penetrates to the deeper layers and reacts with undigested starch, appearing blue-black.
其他選項不符合化學或擴散原理，糖分子亦無法自發結合成澱粉。
Other options do not comply with chemical or diffusion principles, and sugar molecules cannot spontaneously combine into starch.
📌 考試提醒
固體瓊脂板中的酶擴散和消化作用需要足夠時間才能穿透整個厚度。
Enzyme diffusion and digestion in a solid agar plate require sufficient time to penetrate the entire thickness.
常見錯誤：誤以為澱粉分子會快速重新合成，或周圍的澱粉會快速擴散進入中心。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing that starch molecules would quickly resynthesize or surrounding starch would rapidly diffuse into the center.

[題號] 7
📌 參考答案
A. 只有(1)和(2)
A. (1) and (2) only
📌 詳細解釋
細胞核含有遺傳物質（DNA），控制細胞的活動。
The nucleus contains genetic material (DNA) and controls cell activities.
液泡含有細胞液，當中溶有水份、糖分和礦物鹽。
The vacuole contains cell sap, which has dissolved water, sugars, and mineral salts.
植物的細胞壁是全透性的，讓水和所有溶質自由穿過；細胞膜才是差異透性膜。
The plant cell wall is freely permeable, allowing water and all solutes to pass freely; the cell membrane is the differentially permeable membrane.
📌 考試提醒
細胞膜是差異透性的，而細胞壁是全透性的。
The cell membrane is differentially permeable, whereas the cell wall is freely permeable.
常見錯誤：使用錯誤術語如「自由滲透」和「選擇透性」，DSE 標準為「全透性」和「差異透性」。
Common trap：Using incorrect terms like "freely penetrable" and "selectively permeable"; DSE standards are "freely permeable" and "differentially permeable".

[題號] 8
📌 參考答案
A. 溶液I的水潛能最高。
A. Solution I has the highest water potential.
📌 詳細解釋
溶液 I 導致馬鈴薯條質量增加最多（+5%），表示最多水份透過滲透作用進入細胞。
Solution I causes the greatest increase in mass (+5%) of the potato cylinder, indicating the most water enters the cells by osmosis.
這意味著溶液 I 與細胞內液之間存在最大的水勢梯度，其水勢必定是四者中最高。
This implies the largest water potential gradient exists between Solution I and the intracellular fluid, so its water potential must be the highest among the four.
溶液 IV 的質量變化為 0%，表示它是等滲溶液，水勢等於細胞的水勢，而非最低或蒸餾水。
The 0% mass change in Solution IV indicates it is an isotonic solution with a water potential equal to that of the cells, not the lowest nor distilled water.
📌 考試提醒
水份透過滲透作用，由較高水勢的區域淨移動至較低水勢的區域。
Water moves by net flow from a region of higher water potential to a region of lower water potential through osmosis.
常見錯誤：混淆水勢與濃度，誤以為質量減少最少的溶液水勢最高。
Common trap：Confusing water potential with concentration, mistakenly thinking the solution with the least mass decrease has the highest water potential.

[題號] 9
📌 參考答案
D. 它們依賴細胞硬脹來支持。
D. They rely on cell turgidity for support.
📌 詳細解釋
幼嫩草本植物缺乏木質部導管的木質素或堅硬的樹皮提供機械性支持。
Young herbaceous plants lack lignin in xylem vessels or hard bark to provide mechanical support.
它們完全依賴薄壁細胞吸收水份後維持的硬脹度（水壓）來保持直立。
They rely entirely on the turgidity (water pressure) maintained by parenchyma cells after absorbing water to remain upright.
因此，當缺水導致細胞變得軟縮時，草本植物便會迅速萎蔫。
Therefore, when water shortage causes the cells to become flaccid, herbaceous plants will wilt rapidly.
📌 考試提醒
草本植物的主要支持力來自細胞的硬脹度，而木本植物則依賴木質部。
The main support for herbaceous plants comes from cell turgidity, while woody plants rely on the xylem.
常見錯誤：不了解細胞硬脹度（turgidity）對非木質組織的支撐重要性。
Common trap：Not understanding the importance of cell turgidity for the support of non-woody tissues.

[題號] 10
📌 參考答案
A. 下降、下降
A. falls, falls
📌 詳細解釋
管 (1) 含有水，管 (2) 含有 2% 蔗糖溶液，兩者的水勢皆高於外圍的 10% 蔗糖溶液。
Tube (1) contains water and Tube (2) contains 2% sucrose solution; both have a higher water potential than the surrounding 10% sucrose solution.
因此，管 (1) 和管 (2) 內的水份均會透過滲透作用，穿過透析管淨流出至燒杯中。
Therefore, water in both Tube (1) and Tube (2) will flow out into the beaker by net movement through the dialysis tubing via osmosis.
水份流失導致兩支毛細管內的液面同時下降。
The loss of water causes the liquid levels in both capillary tubes to fall simultaneously.
📌 考試提醒
透析管是一種差異透性膜，容許水分子穿過但不容許較大的蔗糖分子穿過。
Dialysis tubing acts as a differentially permeable membrane, allowing water molecules to pass but not larger sucrose molecules.
常見錯誤：錯誤判斷濃度與水勢的關係，誤以為高濃度溶液有較高水勢。
Common trap：Incorrectly judging the relationship between concentration and water potential, mistakenly thinking a higher concentration solution has a higher water potential.

The dialysis tubing in tube (3) is larger, providing a larger surface area in contact with the surrounding solution.

The rate of diffusion and osmosis is directly proportional to the surface area.

成人恆齒列中，位於前方最中央的兩對（標註 1、2）是門齒。

緊接著門齒的尖銳牙齒（標註 3）是犬齒，用作撕裂食物。
The sharp teeth (label 3) immediately next to the incisors are canines, used for tearing food.
標註 4 和 5 是前臼齒，6、7 和 8 則是臼齒，因此選項 A、C 和 D 皆不正確。

人類牙齒的排列順序依次為門齒、犬齒、前臼齒和臼齒。
The sequence of human teeth arrangement is incisors, canines, premolars, and molars.
常見錯誤：未能準確辨認牙齒排列圖上不同種類牙齒的相對位置及數目。
Common trap：Failing to accurately identify the relative positions and numbers of different types of teeth on a dental chart.

📌 參考答案
C. 後排牙齒蛀牙較多。

根據圖表上的符號，代表補過、蛀了及脫落的牙齒幾乎全部分布在臼齒區（標註 6、7、8）。
According to the symbols on the chart, teeth that are filled, decayed, or extracted are almost entirely located in the molar region (labels 6, 7, 8).
這客觀地顯示了蛀牙主要集中在牙床後方的臼齒和前臼齒。
This objectively shows that tooth decay is mainly concentrated in the molars and premolars at the rear of the jaw.
圖表並沒有提供關於琺瑯質厚度或抵抗力的數據，因此無法得出選項 A 或 B 的結論。
The chart provides no data regarding enamel thickness or resistance, so conclusions in options A or B cannot be drawn.

臼齒表面凹凸不平，容易積聚食物殘渣和細菌，較易發生蛀牙。
Molars have uneven surfaces that easily trap food debris and bacteria, making them more prone to tooth decay.
常見錯誤：根據常識推斷未在圖表中顯示的資訊（如琺瑯質厚度），而非單純解讀圖表數據。
Common trap：Deducing information not shown in the chart (like enamel thickness) based on common sense, rather than strictly interpreting the provided data.

📌 參考答案
B. 麵包、牛肉、牛奶
B. Bread, Beef, Milk
📌 詳細解釋
食物 X 含有極高比例的碳水化合物（55.5g），這與麵包這類澱粉質主食脗合。
Food X contains a very high proportion of carbohydrates (55.5g), which matches starchy staple foods like bread.
食物 Y 含有大量蛋白質（14.8g）和脂肪（28.2g）且幾乎沒有碳水化合物，符合牛肉的營養特徵。
Food Y contains high amounts of protein (14.8g) and fat (28.2g) with almost no carbohydrates, fitting the nutritional profile of beef.
食物 Z 含有一定量的蛋白質和碳水化合物，並且富含礦物質（例如鈣），因此最可能是牛奶。
Food Z contains moderate protein and carbohydrates, and is rich in minerals (such as calcium), so it is most likely milk.
📌 考試提醒
辨認食物營養成分時，應留意穀物富含碳水化合物，肉類富含蛋白質和脂肪，奶類富含礦物質。
When identifying food nutrients, note that cereals are rich in carbs, meats in protein and fat, and dairy in minerals.
常見錯誤：誤以為肉類含有大量碳水化合物，或忽略牛奶中的高礦物質特徵。
Common trap：Mistakenly believing meat contains a lot of carbohydrates, or ignoring the high mineral characteristic of milk.

[題號] 15
📌 參考答案
A. 硝酸鹽、碳水化合物
A. Nitrates, Carbohydrates
📌 詳細解釋
蛋白質是含氮的有機物，植物必須從泥土吸收無機的硝酸鹽以獲取所需的氮元素。
Proteins are nitrogen-containing organic compounds; plants must absorb inorganic nitrates from the soil to obtain the necessary nitrogen.
同時，植物利用光合作用製造碳水化合物，將其碳骨架與氮結合，轉化為氨基酸並合成蛋白質。
Simultaneously, plants use photosynthesis to produce carbohydrates, combining their carbon skeletons with nitrogen to form amino acids and synthesize proteins.
鎂化合物主要用於合成葉綠素，而維生素並非合成蛋白質的直接原材料。
Magnesium compounds are mainly used for synthesizing chlorophyll, and vitamins are not direct raw materials for protein synthesis.
📌 考試提醒
植物透過硝酸鹽提供氮，並以光合作用的產物提供碳骨架來合成蛋白質。
Plants synthesize proteins using nitrogen from nitrates and carbon skeletons from the products of photosynthesis.
常見錯誤：誤以為植物從泥土中直接吸收蛋白質，或忘記光合作用產物是所有有機物合成的基礎。
Common trap：Mistakenly thinking plants absorb proteins directly from the soil, or forgetting that photosynthetic products are the basis for synthesizing all organic matters.

[題號] 16
📌 參考答案
D. 紅和藍
D. Red and blue
📌 詳細解釋
根據光譜曲線圖，光合作用率在藍光（約 440nm）和紅光（約 660nm）波段出現最高峰。
According to the action spectrum graph, the rate of photosynthesis reaches its highest peaks in the blue (around 440nm) and red (around 660nm) light wavelengths.
這表示植物的葉綠素最有效吸收這兩種顏色的光波進行光合作用。
This indicates that plant chlorophyll most effectively absorbs these two colors of light for photosynthesis.
綠光波段的光合作用率最低，因為大部分綠光被葉片反射，因此其他選項皆不合理。
The photosynthetic rate is lowest in the green light region because most green light is reflected by the leaves, making other options unreasonable.
📌 考試提醒
葉綠素主要吸收紅光和藍光，並反射綠光。
Chlorophyll mainly absorbs red and blue light, and reflects green light.
常見錯誤：認為綠色植物吸收綠光最有效，因為它們看起來是綠色的。
Common trap：Believing that green plants absorb green light most effectively because they appear green.

[題號] 17
📌 參考答案
A. 地球上動物的總數會減少。
A. The total number of animals on earth would decrease.
📌 詳細解釋
如果只有綠光到達地球，由於植物對綠光的吸收率極低，光合作用率將會大幅下降。
If only green light reaches the earth, the rate of photosynthesis would drop drastically due to the extremely low absorption of green light by plants.
植物製造的食物量減少，導致食物鏈底層的能量供應不足，最終令依賴植物維生的動物數量減少。
The decrease in food produced by plants leads to an insufficient energy supply at the base of the food chain, ultimately reducing the animal population that relies on them.
光合作用減弱會使氧氣產量減少及二氧化碳消耗減少，因此選項 B、C 和 D 錯誤。
Weakened photosynthesis would reduce oxygen production and carbon dioxide consumption, so options B, C, and D are incorrect.
📌 考試提醒
光合作用是生態系統中能量流動的基礎，植物產量直接影響所有消費者的存活。
Photosynthesis is the foundation of energy flow in an ecosystem; plant production directly affects the survival of all consumers.
常見錯誤：誤以為植物在綠光下仍能維持正常光合作用，忽略圖表顯示的吸收谷底。
Common trap：Mistakenly thinking plants can maintain normal photosynthesis under green light, ignoring the absorption trough shown in the graph.

[題號] 18
📌 參考答案
D. 肋間肌舒張，空氣流出肺部。
D. intercostal muscles relax and force air out of the lungs.
📌 詳細解釋
